trust_decision.summary: The registry gRPC server must decide whether the caller may create/update the object (assert_permissions_to_update / assert_permissions) BEFORE turning request-supplied proto bytes into objects, because from_proto runs dill.loads on embedded UDF/profiler bodies; at the pinned commit the handlers deserialize first and check afterwards.

landing_point.why: The summary names the ApplyFeatureView gRPC method; the handler is RegistryServer.ApplyFeatureView, which calls *.from_proto before assert_permissions_to_update.

model deserializer (lower-level public API, gains skip_udf)

fix_sites.module_kind: model deserializer; skip_udf parameter already declared at :568 but ignored

O3_reason_to_dismiss: ApplyMaterialization only checks WRITE_ONLINE for a client-driven bookkeeping call after 'feast materialize' and is not the 'apply feature view' path; ApplyValidationReference belongs to the optional Great Expectations DQM feature, a neighbouring object type the advisory never mentions.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An authorized client applying a FeatureView/ODFV/StreamFeatureView with a real UDF must still have the full transformation stored (the fix re-runs full from_proto after authz); always skipping UDFs or rejecting UDF bodies breaks remote 'feast apply' of on-demand/batch/stream views. ODFV.__init__ must also tolerate a missing transformation when skip_udf is used.

O6_input_shapes: FeatureView spec.feature_transformation.user_defined_function with mode set (factory class) or without mode (PythonTransformation)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: gRPC ApplyMaterialization runs FeatureView.from_proto (full UDF/substrait dill path) on the request before assert_permissions(WRITE_ONLINE); the published fix did not touch it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Materialization bookkeeping, a different RPC with a different action (WRITE_ONLINE) than the apply/update path named in the advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, ~540 lines below; sink in feast/transformation/*.py

O8_uncovered_routes.route: gRPC ApplyValidationReference runs ValidationReference.from_proto -> GEProfiler.from_proto -> dill.loads(profiler.body) before assert_permissions_to_update
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Optional Great Expectations data-quality feature, not a feature view; its profiler is user code by design.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 extra files in feast/ and feast/dqm/profilers/ (other package from the feature-view models)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ApplyFeatureService whose from_proto could embed full FeatureView/ODFV protos instead of projections
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Feature services reference views; a maintainer inlining view specs for convenience would route through FeatureView.from_proto before the check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: UpdateInfra has no permission check at all; an Infra object type carrying a pickled config would reach dill
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: sdk/python/feast/infra/common/serde.py:36 already dill-loads a repo_config byte blob in internal serde, so a pickled infra field is a plausible pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Arrow Flight offline server deserializing a request-supplied FeatureView/ODFV proto (e.g., for on-demand transforms) before its authz check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Offline server already rebuilds DataSource from client protos and comments about FeatureView.from_proto instances (offline_server.py:573).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move assert_permissions_to_update above from_proto in ApplyFeatureView only (impossible without a metadata-only parse), or add skip_udf to StreamFeatureView alone and miss the FeatureView/ODFV transformation, nested-source and substrait paths plus ApplyMaterialization/ApplyValidationReference.
